convention_rule: Four similar objects in a left-to-right row; the single green-lit object's position k (1-4) signals candidate ID Pk (by ID number, not list order).
basis: r04 green 3rd->P3, r05 green 4th->P4, r06 green 2nd->P2 (listed 2nd was P4, so ID-number mapping). r07_A: leftmost of 4 barns green; r07_B: leftmost of 4 hay bales green-lit -> P1. P1 is not client-correct (P3 is).
